items.evidence: main.py headless --ticks 5, no script: screen title, tick 5, all 39 keys of the brief present.
--frame after a run wrote a PNG with IHDR 800x480; frames opened and looked at.
Fresh title texts [Day Market, New season, Records, Stamps, Settings, Quit], menu_index 0; up stays 0, 9 downs stop at 4; Quit at tick 0 with --ticks 100 printed state with tick 0.
Settings texts Language: English / Difficulty: Normal / Season: 7 days; left/right en<->es, easy..hard, 7<->3 days, all stop at ends; Escape and Enter on Back -> title.
Set es/hard/3 in one run; a second run on the same --kept starts es/hard/3; fresh folder: en/normal/7, slots [null,null,null], stamps [], records [].

22 scenarios (title, slots new/continue, settings, records empty/filled, stamps, morning with order/taken/Not enough, stall, day, paused, evenings delivered/failed/stamps/bankrupt, upgrades, season over) run in en and es: same line counts, no es line equal to its en line except Day Market and 08:15; Right on Language turns the settings texts Spanish at once.
lang/en.json and lang/es.json hold all strings; README 'Language: copy lang/en.json to lang/xx.json ...'.
Enter on New season: [New season, Slot 1: Empty, Slot 2: Empty, Slot 3: Empty]; Escape -> title.
Enter on slot 2: morning, day 1, slot 2, coins 50, rep 50, empty stock, prices 4/6/11/14/7/9, upgrades [], crate_limit 8, order null, texts Morning / Day 1 of 7 / Coins: 50.
Easy 60 coins, Hard 40; 3-day season shows Day 1 of 3 with 3 forecast entries; after changing settings to hard/3 and Continue, season_difficulty normal, season_length 7.
Seeds 1-20: 7 entries from sun/cloud/rain/heat, weather = forecast[day-1] on days 1 and 2, Weather: text matches; seed 7 twice gives the same forecast.
Seeds 1-20: every wholesale price is base-1..base+2 (all four offsets seen for each good); rows read like 'Apples: 3 a unit, stock 0'.
Apples at 3: coins 50->32, stock [{6,5}]; second lot [{12,5}] and row 'stock 12'; honey batch days_left null.
Fish 6x9>50: coins and stock unchanged, 'Not enough coins' shown, gone after next word; with 1000 coins 17 apple lots stop at 96 units (17th lot changes nothing).
Day 1 order null; day 2 orders seeds 1-8 have units 4/6/8, pay units*ref*3/2 (e.g. 8 bread for 72), 'Order: 8 Bread for 72'; accept -> taken, 'Order taken: ...'; second accept identical state.
Later run on the same kept: 'Slot 1: Day 1 of 7, 50 coins'; title [Day Market, New season, Continue, Records, Stamps, Settings, Quit].

Day-2 morning (seed 4, with stall, prices, stock) vs Continue in a new run started with seed 99: day, coins, rep, stock, stall, prices, upgrades, forecast, wholesale, order all equal; Enter on an empty slot leaves the slots screen.

Escape on morning/stall/day -> Paused [Paused, Resume, Title], clock stands over 40 ticks; Resume and Escape give identical state; Title after buying apples leaves slot at 50 coins and Continue shows no apples.
Stall texts [Stall, Day 1 of 7, Good: Apples, Price: 4, Stock: 6, Crates: 0 of 8, Enter: open], cursor (0,0), selected apples.
up -> (0,1), up up -> (0,1), down stops at 0, 7 rights -> (5,0), left stops at 0.
next_good x0..6: apples bread cheese fish flowers honey apples; prev_good: honey, flowers; Good/Price/Stock texts follow.
put -> stall [{0,0,apples}], Crates: 1 of 8; put on occupied, 9th crate unchanged; Crates: 8 of 8; take removes; take on empty unchanged; stall ordered by x then y.
Apples price_up x10 -> 12, price_down x5 -> 1, honey up x40 -> 27; Price text follows.
Stall and bread price 8 kept into day 2 morning and the day-2 stall, and through Continue in a later run.
Enter on Stall: screen day, clock 0, speed slow, texts 08:00 and Speed: Slow, counters 0, visitors list of 69.

Lists are well formed (ids 1.., minutes increasing in 0..479, wants distinct and 2/1/2/3) and same seed repeats, but another seed does not give another list: day-1 visitor lists of seeds 5, 6 and 9 are identical, so are 3 and 4, and 7 and 8 (seeds shift the same splitmix stream).
40 ticks: slow 2, fast 8, rush 40, hold 0 (tick 40, screen day); 10 slow ticks then fast: clock 0 at 12 ticks, 1 at 13 (progress kept); texts 08:40, 09:30, Speed: Rush/Fast/Hold.
finish at tick 0 -> evening, clock 480, tick 0; taken/served/walked_out/passed/sales/coins/rep/stock/texts equal to 480 rush ticks (served 15, taken 78).
Same day at slow (9600 ticks), fast (2400) and a mix with hold/fast/rush/slow/finish: no difference from finish in any result key.
Per-minute states over 8 seeds: every aisle visitor x = clock - minute; queue joined = minute + 6; none on aisle past m+5.
Per-minute basket growth over 8 seeds: empty baskets only took front crates, back row only after holding something, only wanted, never duplicate goods.
Apples only crate at column 2 priced 4: every cook wanting apples with units available held 2@4 at m+2 with budget 32; at 5 no cook took; tourists at column 3 took 1@6 (budget 14) and none at 7.
Per-minute over 18 day runs: budget_left never below 0, held units in aisle+queue+tills never above stock.
Per-minute: each visitor leaving cell 5 empty raised passed by 1; with goods joined queue end (or till) with joined = arrival + 6.
Till ends = start + 2 + basket goods; each sale paid total (bargain total - total//10), coins/taken/served/rep moved by it; with batches [6@4,6@5] first apple sale left [4@4,6@5].
Per-minute: a till ending at minute m with a queue took the front at m; a visitor leaving the aisle to an empty queue with a free till was at the till that minute.
Reputation 100, 10 seeds: 10 walkouts, each only once wait >= patience, never a queued wait at/over patience, rep -2 and walked_out +1 each, units released (held<=stock).
Clock 479 vs evening: visitors still present vanished, walked_out/passed/served unchanged, aisle/queue/tills empty.
With second_till: tills has 2 entries every minute, both busy in 55 minutes over 5 seeds, till 2 never took a visitor while till 1 was free.
With Sign an empty-basket visitor took a back-row good first; without Sign that never happened.
Seeds 1-4: taken order with units bought -> 'Order delivered: 72', coins +pay, units gone; without stock 'Order failed', rep -5; not taken -> no line, coins only minus rent.
Bread bought day 1 spoiled that evening ('Bread: sold 0, spoiled 6, left 0'), fish 1 day left then spoiled day 2 evening, apples 5->4, honey stays null.
Seed 12 heat day: apples 5->3, cheese 6->4 without Cool box; with Cool box 5->4; Cool box bought in game on day 1 before a heat day 2: 5->4.
3 crates: Easy 'Rent: 21' coins 39, Normal 'Rent: 26' 24, Hard 'Rent: 36' 4.
Seed 2 evening: Evening, Day 1 of 7, Taken: 60, Served: 10, Walked out: 0, Passed: 46, per-good lines matching sales/stock, Rent: 26, Coins: 66, Reputation: 60, Tomorrow: Heat (forecast[1]).
Upgrades texts [Upgrades, Coins: 80, Next day, Second till: 80, Cool box: 40, Sign: 30, Extra crates: 50, Awning: 35]; Next day -> morning day 2.
Sign: coins 80->50, upgrades [sign], 'Sign: owned'; again unchanged; Second till with 50 -> unchanged + 'Not enough coins'; Extra crates -> crate_limit 12, 'Crates: 0 of 12'.
Hard, 8 crates: coins -6, evening ends 'Bankrupt', slot emptied; Enter -> [Bankrupt, Score: 0, Days: 1, Best: 0, Enter: title]; record bankrupt true.
Easy 3-day idle: evening 'Season over', coins 15; Season over [Season over, Score: 65, Days: 3, Best: 65, Enter: title]; slots empty, title without Continue.

6 seasons ended: records keep 5 (65, 65, 0 d1, 0 d2, 0 d3; last 0 dropped), equal scores in end order; later run shows 'Score 65, 3 days, Easy', 'Score 0, 1 days, Hard, bankrupt'; fresh 'No records yet'.

Evening 'Stamp: First coin', 'Stamp: Sold out', stamps [first_coin, sold_out]; a second season on same kept selling again shows no Stamp line; later run Stamps screen 'First coin: yes', 'Sold out: yes', rest ': no'.
first_coin with a sale, not on an idle day; 8 crates -> full_stall, 7 -> none; easy 3-day finished -> whole_season; normal 3-day bankrupt -> none.
6 apples on 3 crates sold out -> sold_out; crate with no stock -> none; 6 fish bought with no crate and delivered to an order (stock 0) -> none.
Day 2 played after Continue (run started with seed 42) vs unbroken run: visitors, sales, texts, coins, counters, stock identical (served 3, taken 15).
Two identical copies of a kept folder, same seed/ticks/script -> identical JSON; seeds 11 and 12 differ in forecast and wholesale.
15 cases (Escape on Evening/Upgrades, Left/Right/finish on title, put/take/finish/hold on Morning, accept/finish/rush on Stall, rush on Settings/Evening, finish on Paused): state unchanged.
data/goods.json, visitors.json, rules.json (hourly rates, weather weights/W), upgrades.json, stamps.json (thresholds); README 'Changing data' covers good, visitor type, upgrade, stamp.
Stall frame: 6x2 grid, crates lettered and coloured per good (fish blue, flowers pink), yellow cursor at state (3,1), Good: Cheese, Price: 11, Crates: 7 of 8.
Day frames: stall crates, aisle visitors at their cells numbered and coloured by type (4 colours), queue (visitor 17), Till 1 with visitor 16, time, speed, coins, taken, served, reputation.

Title, slots, settings, morning, upgrades, paused, season over frames show texts with the chosen row highlighted, but the Evening frame with 17 texts (order delivered, no stamp) clips the last line 'Tomorrow: Sun' off the bottom of the 480px image (render.py only tightens spacing above 17 lines).
README: keys and how to play, kept folder and its four files, the headless and frame commands, which ran as written.

defects: The seed enters the splitmix64 state linearly (seed*GOLDEN + ...), so nearby seeds give the same random stream shifted by a step: different seeds often produce identical visitor lists (5, 6, 9; 3, 4; 7, 8).
Evening frame with exactly 17 lines (e.g. an order delivered, no stamp) draws the last line 'Tomorrow: ...' half outside the 480px image.
Frame font has no accents: Spanish text is drawn without accents in the PNG (README admits it).
